title_zh: 先去售票处核对港口渡船登船信息

scenario.label_zh: 查询港口渡船的当日信息
scenario.goal_zh: 确认手头旅行博客信息发表于去年，问清售票处位置并决定先核实当日班次再购票

context_zh: 游客在美国港口向工作人员询问渡船信息。
author: author-phase08-a

sentences.speaker: Wendy
sentences.text: Does the ferry leave from this side of the harbor?

sentences.speaker: Caleb
sentences.text: Usually, yes. Are you heading to Pine Island?

sentences.speaker: Wendy
sentences.text: I am. I've got some info from a travel blog, but it was posted last year.

sentences.speaker: Caleb
sentences.text: The boarding point can change. The ticket office has today's departures.

sentences.speaker: Wendy
sentences.text: Is that the blue building beside the water?

sentences.speaker: Caleb
sentences.text: That's it. Check the board inside before you buy a ticket.

sentences.speaker: Wendy
sentences.text: Thanks. I'll go there first rather than wait at the wrong dock.

targets.sense_zh: 供船只停泊的港口（美式拼写）
